look: handmade paper / editorial, warm beige-forward with deep green, gentle

deepGreen.role: primary brand colour; dark-section background; key word / logo / accent

deepGreenBg.role: darker green for full backgrounds / dark scenes

cream.role: warm text colour on green / dark scenes

freshMeadow.role: secondary accent in blocks/illustration — NOT for text

electricLime.role: tiny pop only — logo eye, highlight, kicker

rose.role: readable rose for accent text on beige

usage: Beige + deep green do the heavy lifting; lime and pink are spices (tiny accents, never large areas or body text); meadow for blocks/illustration only.

fonts.note: Video factory currently uses Inter Tight + Playfair Display — align to one pairing if a single brand look is wanted.

logo.mark: one-line elephant, deep green stroke #044617 with lime eye #A5D024 (hides LP + initials LV)

assets: assets/img/brand/ — paper-*.webp (textures), torn-*.png (deckled edges), collage-*.webp/-cut.png (torn-paper collages), brush-*.webp (lime strokes)
